invariants.description: Every public proposal ID has a ProposalSubject role.
All aggregate, signal, and editorial claim fact IDs resolve to canonical facts.
All public rawPostIds are present in facts.discussionPosts.
Every current-window discussion post uses windowStart <= createdAt < windowEnd.
Weekly development views use only weeklyUsable events.
A proposal has at most one public proposal_published logical event.
AA track posts are counted only when post.proposalId is assigned to the track.
HTML and interaction code read intelligenceSnapshot.views only.
Snapshot hash is SHA-256 of canonical serialization excluding metadata.snapshotHash.
Every public metric label includes a clear unit.
